name: Barbell Hack Squat
steps: Stand with a barbell resting on the floor directly behind your calves and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with an upright chest and flat back to grip the bar behind your legs using a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your core and drive firmly through your feet to stand upright as the bar rises closely behind your legs.
Bend your knees and hips smoothly to guide the bar back down behind your calves to the floor.
tips: Keep your chest tall so the bar clears your calves and hamstrings cleanly without rounding your back.
Keep your heels grounded flat on the floor throughout both the lift and descent.
